video.title: AI欧腐《重生后，我投入了黑帮丈夫的怀抱/Reborn into My Mafia Husband’s Arms》
video.desc:
In past lives, Adrian, the heir of a wealthy family, was killed by his fian, stepbrother, biological father and stepmother in collusion. After his death, only discovered that Lucien, the mafia godfather who had once imprisoned him, only avenged him but also committed suicide by swallowing pills. Reborn back to the day when Adrian was about to propose to his fiancée, he decis abandoned his enemies and took the initiative to return to Lucien's side.
前世，富家继承人Adrian被自己的未婚妻、继兄、生父和继母联手害死。死后他才发现，那个曾经囚禁过他的黑手党教父Lucien，不仅为他报了仇，还吞药自尽。重生的阿德里安Adrian回到了即将向未婚妻求婚的那一天，他毅然抛弃了敌人，主动回到了Lucien 身边。
